meta.source: FastNEAR neardata, intents.near, dip4 token_diff events
meta.coverage_note: contiguous window starting Oct 28, 2026; ingestion ongoing
caveats: Window spans a few chain days and keeps growing; some time-of-day bias remains in solver and corridor shares
USD values derived from stablecoin legs where present, else live major-asset prices; unvalued entries excluded from volume shares
Solver side of a bilateral receipt identified as the account with higher global fill count
Explicit fee rate measures fees_collected at the settlement contract only; it does not capture app-layer or off-contract revenue

explicit_fee.finding: The explicit protocol fee at the settlement contract is roughly 0.01 bps per side, hundreds of times below the 5.03 bps revenue rate implied by DefiLlama. Protocol revenue is therefore generated off the settlement contract (application-layer fees or solver arrangements), not by a contract-enforced take. The capture rate behind the break-even model is policy, not protocol.

confidential_flow.identification: This account receives the majority of transfer events on intents.near in the window and never appears as a counterparty in any bilateral fill; tokens sent to it settle outside the public event stream and return later
confidential_flow.method: Per approximate chain day (block height arithmetic from the ingestion start), stablecoin USD entering the treasury via transfer events is compared against stablecoin USD settled in public fills, counted once per settlement receipt. Both sides measure value entering a settlement route once, so the comparison is like for like. Stablecoin legs only; major and unknown tokens are excluded from both sides. The treasury is a routing hub rather than a sink: it pays out almost exactly what it takes in, so these figures describe where activity is routed, not value captured
confidential_flow.finding: More stablecoin value is routed into the confidential path than settles as public fills. The treasury pays out almost exactly what it receives, so this measures routing rather than capture, but the consequence for this analysis is the same: a large share of activity leaves the public event stream, so every figure measured from public fills describes a diminishing slice of the protocol

wash_screen.note: Solver accounts excluded from the round-trip metric since market makers legitimately trade both directions
